text:
Samir Khatri: Morning first-watch triage. Quick snapshot — 42 open tickets, 3 P1s. Two P1s are on hosted API timeouts, one P1 is an embeddings ingestion duplication issue causing customers to get duplicate vectors. I rolled a temporary macro 'embeddings-dup' to ack and gather logs. Can someone pick up the hosted P1 for the 08:30 window?

ops-bot: New escalation created -> ticket #3598, priority: P1, tags: hosted-api, timeouts (escalated by monitoring).

Leah Chen: I can grab #3598 — will triage now. FYI I already patched a routing rule for one of the timeout patterns in staging; will try to repro on prod after triage.

Samir Khatri: Thanks @Leah. For the embeddings dup: I added the macro snippet below and applied to recent matching tickets to collect sample payloads. If you hit anything weird, add it to the ticket thread.

Samir Khatri: ```
// macro: embeddings-dup
Reply: "Thanks — we're investigating duplicated embeddings. Can you paste the payload id and approximate ingestion time? Also include whether you used batch or streaming ingestion."
Actions: add_tag embeddings-dup, request_logs
```

Ivy Morgan: On the embeddings one — I saw a backfill job retry loop in the logs around 03:12 UTC. Might be a race in the backfill coordinator where job state isn't marked durable before retry. Will dig and send a small repro.

Kai Patel: Re: P1 hosted API timeouts — late-night autoscaler burst didn't spin up new pods; looking at cloud metrics now, might be transient GC on the node. If it's GC, we should route to dedicated pool temporarily.

Leah Chen: Update: I've reproduced the timeout on a few requests (seq len ~4k). Captured heap/latency traces and pinned a temporary canary model variant (smaller context) to reduce tail latency. Pushed updates to ticket #3598 and added the logs macro.

Samir Khatri: Great. Action items: 1) @Leah — continue owner for #3598, keep us posted; 2) @Ivy — try the repro and open a small PR for coordinator fix if confirmed; 3) @Kai — validate autoscaler node-level GC hypothesis and propose a short-term routing rule. I'll follow up midday with a summary and adjust macros if we need more data fields.

Kai Patel: Noted. I'll also add a quick runbook note to the P1 template in case we need on-call handoff later. :memo:

Leah Chen: Thanks — if anyone can review my small change to the canary config (/cc @Samir) it's in my branch `leah/p1-timeout-canary`. Should be low-risk.

Samir Khatri: I'll take a look in 15. If it LGTM we'll roll to the two affected zones. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: Daily triage report scheduled at 10:00 UTC — results will be posted to #support-daily-digest.
